info.title: jdkfind
info.description: Locate installed JDKs across Windows, macOS and Linux.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
jdkfind [version] [tool] [options]    Print the selected home, or bin/<tool> path
jdkfind info [version] [options]      Print one installation's details
jdkfind list [options]                List all matching installations

The version is a numeric prefix (21, 21.0, 21.0.5); the selection is stable —
newest version first, installations with a compiler preferred on ties.

Streams: machine-readable output goes to stdout; the human-readable list and
details go to stderr.

Exit codes: 0 = found, 1 = none found, 2 = usage error, 130 = cancelled

options.name: --json
options.description: Write JSON to stdout (list: array; others: single object) [default: False]

options.name: --vendor
options.description: Filter by vendor substring; matches the normalized vendor and the raw string (case-insensitive)

options.name: --distribution
options.description: Filter by distribution substring per the foojay API names (e.g. temurin, zulu, corretto)

options.name: --arch
options.description: Filter by architecture substring (case-insensitive); known aliases match too (x86_64/amd64/x64, aarch64/arm64)

options.name: --release
options.description: Filter by supported javac language level; covers --release/-source/-target compilation

options.name: --jdk-only
options.description: Only installations that ship a compiler (skip runtimes) [default: False]

options.name: --no-probe
options.description: Skip executing each JVM for runtime properties [default: False]

arguments.name: OPERANDS
arguments.description: a digit-led value is a version prefix (21, 21.0.5); anything else is a bin tool name (java, javac)
